description: This file defines the SawVoice class, which is a specific implementation of a SynthVoice in a MIDI synthesizer, utilizing a SawOscillator and an EnvelopeADSR for sound synthesis with an ADSR envelope.

classes.name: SawVoice
classes.description: A sawtooth waveform generator with an ADSR envelope, extending SynthVoice, for use in MIDI synthesis.

methods.name: SawVoice
methods.description: Constructor initializing the oscillator and envelope components.

methods.name: createOscillator
methods.description: Creates and returns a new SawOscillator instance.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Starts the note, setting pitch and amplitude, and triggering the ADSR envelope.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Stops the note and releases the ADSR envelope.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Sets the frequency scaler of the oscillator.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the current audio sample by multiplying the oscillator output with the envelope value.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Returns whether the ADSR envelope has completed.
